scope: Actual candidate bundled FamiStudio text parser and canonical AudioCompiler: musical values, finite-pass timing, cuts, repeated/custom patterns, envelopes, warnings, strict refusal boundaries and separate pure-module packaging parity. No browser, audible or hardware equivalence acceptance.

results.name: Actual candidate HTML initializes and registers the parser and canonical compiler
Selected song timing, repeated patterns, interruption cuts, envelopes, padding, independent previews and quoted metadata
Malformed exports, unsupported project versions and ambiguous attributes are refused
Unsupported loops, variable groove, invalid tempo settings and oversized arrangements are refused
Pattern instances, hidden notes and event identity are validated
Invalid musical notes, unsupported effects and broken instrument references are refused
Duplicate channels, DPCM and expansion content are refused
Envelope shape, values, loops, modulation and volume scaling are validated
Options, control characters and file-size limits are enforced
Fixed FamiTracker tempo, dynamic-envelope timing and noise-mode boundaries are enforced
Standalone UMD registers without editor globals and agrees with the bundled parser
Bundled canonical compiler accepts the bundled parser output without normalization loss
